paragraphs: R' Pedaya. Teacher of R' Yehoshua ben Levi; bar Kappara said to him. I have not found that bar Kappara said to him, only that bar Kappara spoke to R' Pada, his sister's son mentioned above. R' Assi and R' Yehoshua ben Levi in his name: Jerusalem Talmud Nazir 6:9:6 [Heilprin: 6:10]. Rav Huna in his name: Hallah 3:3. Ze'ira in R' Pedaya's name: Terumot 4:7:8 [Heilprin: 4:8]. In Jerusalem Talmud Ta'anit 4:1:3: R' Ze'ira, R' Hiyya, R' Yehoshua ben Levi in R' Pedaya's name. R' Hiyya in his name [the parallel inserts R' Hoshaya ben Levi]: Jerusalem Talmud Nazir 6:9:6 [Heilprin: 6:10]; see there. R' Yehoshua ben Levi in his name: Pe'ah 4:5, Terumot chapter 5; see above. R' Yonah, R' Hiyya (see there), R' Yosi in his name: Ma'aser Sheni 2:3:3 [Heilprin: 2:6]. R' Simon in his name: Jerusalem Talmud, Ellu Devarim and Ḥagigah 3:4:2, Ḥomer Ba-Kodesh.
